revenue.source: Adjusted revenue (non-GAAP) per GE Aerospace 4Q2024 and 4Q2025 earnings releases (8-K, sec.gov ge4q2024earningsrelease / ge4q2025earningsrelease), rounded to $0.1B. GAAP revenue was $38.7B (FY24) and $45.9B (FY25); adjusted basis used so it matches operating profit basis. FY2023 not found (search quota exhausted).

operating_income.source: Operating profit (non-GAAP) $7.3B FY24 (Q1'25 release guidance table / 4Q24 release) and $9.1B FY25 (2025 Annual Report, geaerospace.com), rounded. GAAP EBIT not found. FY2023 not found.

d_and_a.source: stockanalysis.com GE cash flow statement, Depreciation & Amortization (FY23 1,179; FY24 1,184; FY25 1,220); consistent with bullfincher.io ($1.18B/$1.18B/$1.22B). Secondary data provider, not the 10-K directly.

capex.source: stockanalysis.com GE cash flow statement, Capital Expenditures (FY23 862; FY24 1,032; FY25 1,273), shown as positive. Secondary provider; verify against 10-K FY2025 (accession 0000040545-26-000008).

revenue_growth.source: Analyst assumption: FY25 adjusted revenue grew ~21% and FY24 ~10% on record backlog/services demand; fade from 12% to 7% as growth normalizes. Company 2026 guidance not found.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY25 operating margin ~21.5% (9.1B/42.3B) and FY24 20.7%; modest expansion to 22% held flat (FLIGHT DECK lean/services mix, offset by tariffs and equipment mix).

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate blended effective rate for GE Aerospace, between 15% US statutory-with-credits and 21%; not sourced from filing, reviewer should verify.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY25 D&A 1,220 / GAAP revenue 45.9B = 2.7%, in line with history.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY25 capex 1,273 / GAAP revenue 45.9B = 2.8%; stays elevated for MRO and manufacturing capacity expansion.

wacc.source: Assumption: ~4.3% risk-free + beta ~1.2 x 5% ERP, low-leverage capital structure, investment-grade debt; no provider data retrieved.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth consistent with air-traffic growth and inflation, below WACC.

net_debt.source: Short-term borrowings 1,686 (10-K FY2025 Note 10, acc. 0000040545-26-000008) + long-term borrowings ~18,800 (Yahoo/Zacks Q4'25 summary, rounded) = ~20,486 total debt, excl. leases; less cash, equivalents and restricted cash 12,400 (same source). Short-term investments not found/assumed 0. Approximate; verify.

diluted_shares.source: PROXY: Q1 2025 total average equivalent diluted shares 1,078M (10-Q ge-20250331). FY2025 weighted-average diluted not found; likely overstated due to buybacks. Reviewer should replace with FY2025 10-K figure.
